L(a) > commitment margin?

and no-progress guard clear?

report the technical issue

div.style: color: rgb(255, 234, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Multiple reasons may apply.
Do not collapse to a single word.
Suggested codes: GAIN_SURVIVES_SCENARIOS,
AMBIGUOUS_CAPABILITY, INSUFFICIENT_RESERVE,
THERMAL_LIMIT, GRIP_LIMIT, ELIGIBILITY_UNKNOWN,
INPUT_STALE, SOLVER_TIMEOUT, NO_FEASIBLE_REFERENCE,
MODEL_OUT_OF_DOMAIN
